10Neurolinguistic Programming refers to the three most important facets in creating our human experience: neurol­
ogy, language and programming. The neurological system 
regulates how our bodies function, language determines how we interact and communicate with other people, and our programming determines the images and models of the world we create. NLP describes the relationship between the mind (neuro) and language (linguistic) and how they impact on our body and behaviour (programming).
Neuro – the nervous system through which a 
new experience is received through our five senses and processed.
Linguistic – the verbal and non-verbal communication 
systems through which neural representations are coded, ordered and given meaning.Programming – the ability to organize our communication 
and neurological systems to achieve specific desired goals and results.
Where did NLP come from?NLP originated in the mid-1970s, when Richard Bandler, a maths student at the University of California with a strong interest in computer sci-ence and psychology, working together with one 
NLP.indd   10 16/06/2011   16:59:36
11of his lecturers, linguist John Grinder, began leading weekly therapy meetings that involved copying the content and style of psychotherapist Fritz Perls, who had founded the Gestalt therapy movement. This attempt to replicate the results of another person by adopting their behaviours and methods (including the moustache, chain-smoking and German accent – which eventually were deemed unneces-sary!) ultimately led to the discipline of ‘modelling human excellence’.
They then went on to study Virginia Satir, who devel-
oped conjoined family therapy, and Milton Erickson, who is the father of modern clinical hypnotherapy.One of Bandler and Grinder’s early books was entitled The Structure of Magic, and as Arthur C. Clarke once said: ‘Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.’ Many people have drawn similar conclusions regarding NLP . This mind science has swept across the world over the last 35 years, and using its techniques people have freed themselves of long-standing fears and phobias in a matter of minutes, or rapidly reduced the impact of the memory of a horrible experience that may have hindered them for many years.
We are led to believe that meaningful change takes 
time. We have all been introduced to the philosophy of ‘no pain, no gain’, and when a new and contrary idea is intro-duced, we often find it hard to believe. NLP is the kind of 
NLP.indd   11 16/06/2011   16:59:36
12practice that seems ‘too good to be true’, which means that it has attracted both advocates and doubters, many of the doubters being among traditional psychologists whose work derives from Sigmund Freud. Let’s look at how NLP differs from traditional psychology.

134. Where does NLP fit into 
traditional psychology?
NLP has been described as part of the next generation of psychology. However, it has not yet been accepted by mainstream academia, and is not seriously studied as a branch of psychiatry or psychology.
Traditional Freudian psychology and psycho-therapy requires a large commitment of time as the client tries to uncover unconscious pro-
cesses that determine conscious behaviour, sometimes hav
-
i
ng to go back to relive painful or traumatic experiences.
Counselling is a shorter process, usually undirected by 
the counsellor, who helps the client to explore feelings and behaviour around a specific issue such as bereavement.
Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) is task-centred 
work that identifies a problem behaviour and how the mind thinks about it and therefore behaves in regard to it. CBT lit-erally refers to how thoughts/mental processes (cognition) affect behaviour. CBT then aims to alter those beliefs and thought processes, so influencing the behaviour towards a positive state for the client.
NLP has its roots in the field of behavioural sci-
ence, developed by Ivan Pavlov, B.F . Skinner and Edward Thorndike. It uses physiology (physical and biological 
NLP.indd   13 16/06/2011   16:59:36
14states) and the unconscious mind to change thought pro-
cesses and therefore behaviour.
How is NLP different from psychotherapy?
NLP is based on ‘modelling’ rather than ‘theory’. A model is a description of how something works, without any commit-ment regarding why it might be that way. NLP and psycho-therapy have different underlying assumptions about the human mind and its connections with the body as a whole. NLP and traditional psychology have different methodolo-gies, different measures and different concepts in practice. Major differences include:•
 NLP 
is not a model of psychopathology (study of men-
tal illness). NLP makes no diagnoses about a person’s mental health or illness. Its focus is purely on results. It proposes that people are not broken – they work perfectly to produce the results they are getting even if the results are not desirable. If a person doesn’t like the results they are getting, NLP provides tools to help them get the results they desire.
•
 T
raditional psychology and psychotherapy patients 
complain that their sessions lack structure: they go in, let their thoughts wander for 50 minutes, and leave without any sense of progress; then they repeat this ritual for an indeterminate amount of time, sometimes ten years or more. Often, after years of psychotherapy, 
NLP.indd   14 16/06/2011   16:59:36
15psychoanalysis or psycho-pharmaceutical treatment, while problems may have been explored and brought to conscious awareness, and even treated to reduce their effects, a person is still left with ongoing patterns that resulted from a particular situation or experience. Resolution is often left unfinished. This is not to say that traditional psychological models are useless or unhelpful. Many people have been greatly helped by them, and I would encourage anyone to explore them if that is their interest. But there’s so much more that can be accomplished in far less time. For those who have already invested in psychotherapy for a number of years, NLP can be an important finishing or resolution process when psychotherapy has concluded or reached a point of diminishing returns.
•
 NLP 
is non-exclusive. In NLP we encourage people to 
make the most of any resource they wish to use. NLP works well either as a primary or complementary means of self-exploration and change. It doesn’t take an adversarial position to psychotherapy, traditional medi-cine, or other alternative approaches, and clients are free to pursue any and all other avenues while exploring NLP . Some psychotherapists are equally non-exclusive and work well in cooperation with NLP coaches and therapists.
NLP.indd   15 16/06/2011   16:59:36
16NLP and the parts model
Traditional psychology divides the mind into three essen-tial parts: the id, the ego and the superego. While not 
all branches of psychology ‘buy’ this tripartite model, it remains the central and most widely used model in psycho-logical literature and practice.
NLP also has a ‘parts model’, but it’s metaphorical, 
positive and extensible. NLP proposes that internal ‘parts’ should be understood and used metaphorically rather than 
as literal fact.
The NLP parts modelIn the NLP model, each of us has a non-predefined multitude of identity ‘parts’, some prominent at one time, others prominent at other times, all interacting with each other in some way – even 
if that interaction is characterized by silence or opposition.
Most of us have heard the expression, ‘Part of me wants 
to do this, and part of me wants to do that.’ In NLP this is called ‘parts incongruity’.
No part of us is considered dark or evil in NLP . Every 
part has a positive intention and a useful purpose, even if it’s presently trying to fulfil its intention in a problematic way. Additionally, new parts can be created as needed and old parts can be changed or merged with ease.
Parts can form teams, and teams of parts can move 
through any number of processes for a given goal or purpose such as emotional support, creativity, healing, 
NLP.indd   16 16/06/2011   16:59:36
17reality-checking, planning, critiquing, approving, action, etc.
Other features of NLP
• NLP is non-Aristotelian. This means that NLP is proc-
ess- and structure-oriented, not classification-oriented. NLP proposes that putting people into categories of personality type or psychopathology promotes their getting or staying stuck, rather than assisting them to grow, change and heal.
•
 NLP 
is post-Newtonian. This means that NLP is firmly 
based on late 20th-century advances in physics, which observe that the universe is made up not of a collection of objects or things but of patterns and processes.
•
 NLP 
is not reductionist. NLP considers reductionism 
– such as the belief that our thoughts, feelings and experiences are ‘just’ the result of genetics or chemi-cal processes in the brain – to be the result of linguistic confusion.
•
 NLP 
is not objectivist. NLP doesn’t recognize 19th-cen-
tury objectivism (a belief in absolute objective reality or the belief that ‘subjective’ equates to ‘invalid’).
•
 NLP 
is not linear. NLP doesn’t limit itself to linear cause–
effect thinking. It prefers whole systems thinking. Whole 
NLP.indd   17 16/06/2011   16:59:36
18systems tend to be self-organizing and too complex for useful linear, cause–effect analysis.
•
 NLP 
is efficient. NLP doesn’t pursue unresolvable cause–
effect, question–answer sequences such as, ‘Why? … Because … Why? … Because … Why? … Because …’ ad infinitum, since for every answer to ‘Why?’, the ques-tion ‘Why?’ can be applied again. There is literally no end to such cause–effect sequences, and thus no sat-isfying resolution. With a few very specific exceptions, NLP prefers to ask more useful questions such as, ‘How? What? When? Where? Who?’ NLP considers that taking long personal histories from clients for causal analysis is essentially an expensive waste of time. NLP does work with personal history when appropriate – directly, as it’s presently coded in a person’s mind. NLP has powerful tools that a person can use to make positive changes in their ongoing experience of personal history and its meaning, patterns developed as a result of life expe-riences, and other factors connected with their past – without drugs, hypnosis, or years of analysis.
•
 NLP 
is not statistics-based. NLP observes that statistics 
cannot measure or predict a particular person’s subjec-tive experience, since subjective experience is under-stood by internal, not external sensory experience. NLP is the first science based on internal sensory experience.
NLP.indd   18 16/06/2011   16:59:36
19• NLP does not share the same definition of ‘behaviour’ 
with psychology. As Bandler and Grinder pointed out in 1980, ‘NLP includes within its descriptive vocabulary terms which are not directly observable.’ In other words: ‘Just because they can’t see it, that doesn’t mean you’re not doing it or experiencing it.’ And: ‘Just because they can’t reproduce it, that doesn’t mean it didn’t work for you.’ In NLP , behaviours include thought structures like beliefs and values, patterns and sequences of cogni-tion, memory, sensory representations, linguistic struc-tures in thinking, etc., none of which can be directly observed externally, nor can their effects be directly, causally connected with measurable external observa-tions. Yet no reasonable person would deny the impor-tance and meaning of such internal experiences.
For a practical example of the NLP process, and how words can change your focus and in turn change how you feel, try the following exercise. Be aware of how you feel after you finish.
Imagine you’re on a beautiful beach on a lovely warm 
day. The skies are blue with a few wisps of cloud, the sun is shining brightly. Feel the sand between your toes as the sun warms your skin. Notice the brilliant white sand and the turquoise ocean. Hear the waves gently lapping on the shore and the breeze gently rustling the leaves on the palm 
NLP.indd   19 16/06/2011   16:59:36
20trees. Smell the fresh scent of pineapples wafting over from the nearby fruit stand. Go over and choose a pineapple from the bucket of icy water they are standing in. Look at it closely, its prickly skin and its green crown. Notice how it feels cool and heavy in your hand. Press it gently with your thumb to feel how ripe and juicy it is. Lift it to your nose and be aware of its aroma. Take a knife and cut a wedge. Be aware of the sound it makes as you slice into the flesh. Notice the juices flowing from the sweet, aromatic fruit as the smell becomes stronger. Lift it to your mouth and take a nice deep bite into your wedge of golden, juicy pineapple. The sweet juices create a party in your mouth and everyone is invited. A dribble of juice drips down your chin.It’s important to remember that the above exercise is just a collection of words. A number of the words would have trig-gered mental, emotional and physical responses. The com-mon assumption is that words are just describing meanings. But the truth is that they are creating your reality. Many 
of you would have felt warm, relaxed and may even have been salivating during the above exercise. This experience was created by words (language) impacting on your mental focus and nervous system (new experience impacting on the five senses) which gives you a new sensory experience (new programming).

215. Basic assumptions of NLP
Below are the eleven basic principles that underpin NLP:1.
 Ther
e is a structure to experience. We all have pat-
terns or structures to the way we think. The ability to change the process by which we experience reality can 
be more valuable than changing the content of our 
experience of reality.
For example, if you like strawberry cheese-cake, understand the process that you go through to get to the outcome of pleas-ure. Use that process on a food that you 
don’t enjoy so much, such as spinach, and you may find that all of a sudden you enjoy spinach more than you usually do. By changing the structures, patterns and processes of the way we think, we literally change our experience, which will also have an impact on how we think about past events.
2.
 The 
meaning of your communication is the response 
you get.  People constantly receive information that is then 
filtered through their internal mental map of the world. How you communicate must be constantly adjusted so the message you give is the one that is received.
NLP.indd   21 16/06/2011   16:59:37
223. All distinctions that we are able to make regarding 
our environment, experiences and behaviour are rep-resented through our five senses (seeing, hearing, feel-ing, smelling and tasting).
4.
 W
e have everything we need on board already – all 
that we need to create change is already within us. From our vast database of thoughts, feelings, memo-ries and sensations we can construct new mental pat-terns to allow us to achieve our goals and dreams.
5.
 The 
map is not the territory. As human beings, we can 
never know reality. We will only ever know our percep-

Introduction
What Is NLP?
Did you know that you can put a stop to your bad habits like smoking
or eatin g junk food through hypnosis? Think about how much this
could change your life and help you open the door to a more
prosperous life! Did you know that you can learn many new and
exciting things through NLP practices that may help you improve
yourself and your life? Althou gh you may have been unaw are, there
are many ways that you can use NLP methods to improve yourself
and your experience!
Your first question may be, “What exactly is NLP or Neuro-Linguistic
Programming?” You may have never even heard this term before, let
alone know what it means and what it’s all about! This is a fair and
essential question! When learning about any new topic, it’s vital to
understand the foundations of it. This could not be truer for the issue
of NLP as well!
Neuro-Linguistic Programmin g was created in the 1970s by a pair of
self-help trainers in California . It is an approach that attempts to aid
communication skills, psychotherapy , and personal development.
Based on the idea of this therapy, there is a connection between our
brains (neuro), language (linguistic), and learned behavioral patterns
(programming). It is believed  these three things can be changed to
alter and, hopefully , improve one’s behavior or accomplish specific
goals. The creators of this approach, as well as many others who
practice or use it, claim that an entire slew of issues, problems, and
obstacles in life can be solved through this self-help therapy .
Depression, addictions, phobias, allergies, the common cold, or
learning disorders are just a few that are believed to be treatable
through this therapy . There have even been claims that some have
been treated in as short as a single session! 
There are also many different strategies and types of Neuro-
Linguistic Programming, and in the coming chapters, we will explore
how you can implement them into your life to make positive changes
that will, hopefully , lead to outstanding personal success! A few of
these strategies are hypnosis, memory alterations, and reframing.
Although these may seem like very foreign and even strange
concepts to you now, don’t worry! This book will help you to explore
many of the different NLP topics and help you to understand just
what they are! Let’ s begin!
In this section, we are going to take some time to shift our focus and
spend a bit of time looking at NLP. The idea of NLP, known  as neuro-
linguistic programming, was first developed by Richard Bandler and
John Grinder in 1976. This is going to be comprised of three parts
including the neuro that is going to focus on the neurology , the
linguistics that will refere nce back to language, and then
programming that will refer to the function of that neural language.
These men spent some of their time studying three individuals and
their ability to change up the feelings and thoughts that they had.
Over the years, many have adopted these ideas, although there is
some criticism out there that looks at the legitimacy of the results of
the study .
NLP is more of a thought, rather than a process, that can be used on
other people. It is more of something that you should conc entrate on
yourself. The basic ideas that come with NLP are that you want to
change the thoughts and the feelings that are inside yourself. Doing
this is excellent for those who would like some relief from things like
depression, anxiety , and some of the other mental illnesses that are
out there. These individuals may feel that there is a specific thought
or another belief that is holding them back, and when they can make
changes to these things, the individual can change their life.
An excellent example of this would be when someone decides to
make themselves believe that they like exercising, even if they
disliked it ahead of time. Some people have found that using the
tactics that come with NLP can bring them some success. But some
have criticized the capabilitie s of this process and how well it can
work for those who choose to use it  .
There are going to be some benefits that come with neurolinguistics
programming, no matter what side of the debate you are on, but
there are some issues because it can be used as a tactic for
manipulation. NLP intends to be able to look inward to figure out
what makes the person unique and their person. The things that
form the beliefs of that person are also going to indicate the quality
of life they are going to have . The idea here is that by changing up
these beliefs, it is easier for that person to change or improve
different parts of their life.
Some manipul ators will learn about the NLP ideas and then will use
these in more dangerous manners. These manipulators are going to
use some of the tactics that come with NLP to try and convince their
victims to do things that may harm the victim, but which are going to
benefit the manipulator in one way or another .
Now, you may be wondering how someone would be able to use the
ideas of NLP to manipulate you. First, we need to take a look at what
some of the tactics of NLP are, and then we can see that there are
many ways that the manipulator can use this against you.
There is some  positivity in this way of thinking, so even  for those
who don’t find this in their lifestyle in the form of manipulation can
find that practic ing NLP, or at least learning more about how it works,
will help them in different ways. Let’s take a look at some of the parts
that come with NLP in this section and why it can be such a powerful
tool.
How We Receive Information
The world that we live in is going to be carted based entire ly on what
we decide to put our focus towards. What we choose to put all of our
energy toward s is going to help to build up the foundations for what
we think, feel, love, express,  work, and do. So basically , the things
that we put our focus on is going to make us into the individual we
are today , and it is the reason  that we are so different from everyone
else in our world.
We can see this just by looking at the different areas a person can
live in. Someo ne who has always lived in California is going to see
the world in a different way than someone who lives in rural Texas.
These are both humans who live in the United States and may have
been born there, they are going to have completely different lives,
and this leads them to have different morals, beliefs, and
perspectives. You are only going to notice what you tune your
attention on, and not what other people do. Your world is going to be
so different than the one that is going on around you. For example, it
is possible that you would work at the same place for years and have
no idea how many car dealerships are present on the route that you
usually take to get to work. You may take the same streets to the
same place for work, each day, every week, and for years at a time,
and never realize that you go past three dealerships along the way  .

misunderstand what is going on with this art form. It is common to
see the word manipulation and believe automatically that the other
person is trying to be emot ionally abusive, mean, and cruel. We
automatically associate a lot of negative traits back to the words.
While people can use manipulation negatively , it is essential to
remember that there are some positive parts of manipulation as well.
Because so many people see manipulation as a negative thing, it
can prevent them from realizing just how powerful of a psychological
art form manipulation can be. Furthermore, many people fail to
understand that pretty much each of us already uses manipulation in
one manner or another—just by living our day-to-day lives. While we
may not automatically see this kind of behavior as manipulation, we
all will have some degree of practice with using it.
Learning how to manipulate  effectively doesn’t mean that you are
heading out into the world and trying to create some abusive

means that you know what  you want, and you have refined the

someone doesn’t want to give in to what you want, they won’t.
Manipulation isn’t all about the pressure put on the other person. The
best manipulators don’t force someone into doing something that
they don’t want to do. Instead , it is more about helping someone see
the value in helping you and doing what you would like and then
building up from there. Before we start to look at some of the

which happens  first; and the persuasion, which is going to take place

show up after the manipulation. Understanding that there is more to
the art of manipulation than just the act of manipulation itself is going
to help you understand more about what can make the process more
successful. While beginners may think that they can do it without the
persuasion and the analysis aspects, you will quickly find that the
results aren’t as good if you miss these two parts and that you are

This is an example of a manipulator . The manipulator has found a

If you encoun ter an excellent manipulator , someone more of a

Chapter 1: What is NLP?
In order to understand the topic  easily and clearly , there is a need to know
what the acrony m NLP means, its full meaning, the benefits, the uses, and
also any pros and cons. The meaning of the acronym NLP is Neuro-
Linguistic Programming. It also involves three dif ferent components.
In simple terms, Neuro-Linguistic Programming is broken down into:
Neur o: This means the neurological part
Linguistic : It is the language that is used
Programming : Refers to the language used for the neural functions.
In short, Neuro-Linguistic Programming means the language used to
understand the mind. A simple  example will help us unders tand better .
Have you ever had to communic ate with another person and you do not get
to understand each other? One of the reasons could be a language barrier .
This mostly happens when you are from dif ferent regions.
This happens when you visit a new and foreign country; you get hungry and
decide to look for a restaurant. You get the menu and decide to get a steak,
only to be disappointed later when lamb chops are offered. This is because
of the typical relationship that a person has with their unconscious mind.
Every human being loves a positive life, healthier relationship, having
peace with the member of their family , being healthy , having a good diet,
and more money . But the last outcome might frustrate when there is no
proper communication and poor delivery of expectations.
There is a very strong statement in NLP, the unconscious mind is definitely
the goal-getter while the conscious mind always the goal-setter . In simple
terms, the uncon scious mind is not set out to frustrate or discourage anyone.
But it is suppose d to help you get that what you have planned and achieving
your mission. The downside is when there is no proper communication, a
lot of expectation and no plan that is outlined. There will be a constant
frustration and eventually more “Lamp Chops” will be served.
At this point, there is a clear general picture of what NLP is. Now , we need
to know the technical explanatio n of NLP and how it is applied. Simply put
NLP involves the balance between personal development and
communication. It was developed in the ‘70s in the United States,
California by Richard Bandler and John Grinder . There was a link between
the three components; the neurological part (neur o), the language
(linguistic) and the behavioral patterns that a person has and developed
through experiences (programming) . They also believed that there is a
chance that the components can be altered and make a person achieve their
plans and meet their goals.
Grinder and Bandler believe that the methods used for NLP can sharpen the
skills and make people exceptional and that anyone can achieve those skills.
And they also state that NLP methods can be used to treat different ailments
like depression,  tic disorder , phobias, short-sightedness, common cold,
allergies, and also learning disorders.
Most companies and hypnotherapists use NLP for marketing, they do that
when they organize seminars, workshops, training for single businesses or
for agencies of the government.  NLP is not a pseudoscience and the claims
laid out have no evidence that it has worked. It is believed to be outdated
and cannot give actual and accurate information on how the brain works.
The theory used in the neurological approach is said to contain errors.
The claims that were made by Grindr and Bandler is said to contain flaws in
the meth odology used and does not support any claim. It is believed that
there more than two studies that have produced better claims as compared
to the claims that were considered extraordinary by Bandler and Grinder
and even other practitioners. There are some hypnotherapists who have
adopted the method an approach . Even companies that deal with marketing
and training for government agencies and also businesses.
 
The Impact of the Conscious and Unconscious Mind
Have you ever had a thought that you could change one personal habit? Just
one habit you will break. The habit can be:
·          Is it possible to have a presentation and be calm about it, no
tension and anxiety?
·          Reduce the number of minutes and hours that are spent on social
media
·          Avoid procrastination and get things done and when they should
·          Reduce of snack intake, like not be eating a whole bowl of ice
cream or crackers in one sitting.
 
The Conscious and Unconscious Mind
When that is achieved, it is possible to achieve your goals. It is because
your unconscio us mind always thinks that is what you need. NLP is
normally used as a manual by the brain, and when you accept to involve the
NLP, it’s definitely like training  your mind. Training it to be fluent in the
language of your mind and when that is done. It becomes like a helpful
“server” and your unconscious  mind will then know what you need and
believe it’ s paramount for your life.
NLP also involves great communication with a person and others. Mainly
developed by approaches and models that are considered excellent and
efficient. Mostly  used by therap ists who have results out of that with their
patients. Most people believe that NLP is a collection of od techniques,
approaches, and tools. But in real sense it is more than that, it is the attitude
and methods that are used to know that planned goals, the approaches to
achieve positive results. It is important to know about the methods and
tricks used, in order to know how to treat and control your mind, a person’ s
state emotionally , and lastly their own life.
 
The History of NLP
Having known the meaning and impact of NLP, it is also important to know
how NLP started. It is known that the ones who started this theory , Brandler
and Grinler, stated NLP to be a set of plans, the method used from the
initial stage of the application. They borrowed the idea from different
people, this included Milton Erickson, Fritz Peris, and Virginia Satir. They
also used theories from Noam  Chomsky , Gregory Bateson, and Alfred
Korzybski. And coupled all that with the tricks, plans, techniques, and ideas
of Carlos Castaneda.
From their 1975  book, they wrote it to be used for therapy techniques. They
claim the method used will perfectly work with their structure  for therapy
healing. They stated that their technique is meant to help gather information
to challenge the language a client uses and to advance their thinking. And
that when the linguistic part is challenged, general information specified,
then there is a very high chance that recovery will take place.
It is been many years since NLP evolved, the strategy and approach have
really grown and it is used in for different issues and situations. NLP is
mainly in terms of observation, habits, and behavior . And the goal is to
uncover and disclose the patterns of life that will work well. And also know
of the patterns that do not work well. When the patterns are known, then it
is advisa ble to strengthen what  works and ensure what does not work is
known and it is changed.
The Main and Cor e Concepts of NLP
From the previous chapters, we discussed the three components of NLP.
This part will discuss more the three components and the concepts that
centrally af fects NLP .
Subjectivity
With the experiences that we have, any person is able to have subjective
representations. According to Bandler and Grinder , the representation is
made up of five senses and the language used. The traditional senses of
audition, olfaction, gustation, and vision are what makes up the subjective
conscious experience. A good example is when we have someth ing “on our
mind”, and then think of what will happen “what we see”, “what we hear”
and “what we taste”. Then it will come to “what we feel”, “what we smell”
and then naturally “what we think”. The subjective representations develop
a pattern, structure and affect a person. At this point, NLP is considered as
being that study that is used for any subjective experience.
A person’ s behavior is mainly known and termed by the sense-based and
subjective representations. It can be non-verbal or verbal communication,
can be incompe tent, or considered a pathological habit that equally affects
any skillful habit. The habits can be altered when manipulated or modified
by the representations of the senses.
Consciousness
This happens when a person’ s notion is conscious and chan ges into an
unconscious component and conscious component. The represen tations that
are subjective happens on the awareness of that person and that is referred
to as the unconscious mind.
 
Learning
It uses the meth od of imitation to learn, it is also known as modeling. It is
known to be able to help produce experience in any activity . The most
important part is knowing and explaining the description of the activities
involved.  And know of the experience involved and the outcome.
 
The Pillars of NLP
There are four well-known pillars or foundations that are of NLP, they
include:
Rapport
With NLP it is guaranteed that anyone will build and maintain a good
relationship with other people around them. This is described as the ability
to know  and create a connectio n with other people quickly . It will help in
creating trust with others and it is built quickly when there is an
understanding. By knowing other people preferences, their prediction, and
accessing what their plans are.
Awareness of the Sensory
This s mainly achieved by interacting with other people. For instance, when
you get invited to another person’ s house. The first thing you will notice is
their décor, the smell, the colors  used, and any sound around. This is mostly
different from what you have in your house. With Neuro-linguistic
programming – NLP, helps to know that you will notice that everything
around you is richer well you pay more attention and use your senses
wholly .
 
Outcome Thinking
The outcome is always referre d to or known as the goal when you do
something. They help in linking to what a person wants or they prefer to
achieve. This helps to avoid thinking about any negative outcom e, and it is
very healthy for the mind and soul. This approach helps in making crucial
and the best positive choices and decisions.
Flexibility in a Person’ s Behavior
This means a person is able to comfortably do something differently as
compared to what they are used to. This happens when what you normally
do and the way you do it, is not practical and responsive. When practicing
NLP, it is imperative to be flexible to be successful. NLP helps  to get new
perspectives and also in building behaviors that have a positive impact.
 
Why does a Person need to Learn about NLP?
The benefits and uses for NLP have been outlined. We need to know again
why you need to learn about NLP . There are several reasons including;
·          One becomes a powerful and great communicator .
·          One becomes skillful in detecting non-verbal communication.
·          Increase the subconscious mind and sensory awareness.
·          Empowerment is motivated.
·          Reduce fears and phobias.
·          Able to think well and control emotions.
·          Develop well in business and personal friendship and relationship.
·          Success rate and achievement are increased.
·          Do away with negative behaviors and train to be a positive person.
·          Being able to positively get information from other people.
·          Communicate ef ficiently and ef fectively .
 
The Levels of NLP T raining
After knowing the importance of NLP training, it is important to know the
levels to under go to be success ful. There are several institutions that are
known to organize, oversee and are accredited institutions to offer such
programs. It is advisable to be in one institution when unde rtaking the
course. There are three levels of NLP training;
NLP Practitioner
This is considere d the entry-level in NLP training, no requireme nt is needed
for this experience, and anybody  can enroll. It involves learning  the basic of
NLP and the techniques used, the basic components and how to apply them.
They are thought of how to apply the skills and to apply all the elegance.
For successful dischar ge of the duties, they are thought about all the skills
and techniques to use; while ensuring they have positive addition in their
lives.
The studies involve how to manage challenges in businesses, relationships,

NLP Master
This second step adds more material to learn and more details and complex

This level equips people with developments aspects and techniq ues used in

The course also covers their personality , the strategies used that are

After the training, they are meant to be presenters who are transformed and

Chapter 2: NLP Fundamentals
NLP describes human habits as been influenced by habits and behavioral
patterns. When one is able to know of their habits, patterns, and behavior
then it’s possible to know how to control their lives. The topic of NLP is
broad and wide, in short NLP is about what motivates us, and the reason
behind the decisions we make. And they are referred to as metaprograms.
 
What ar e Metapr ograms?
It is the menta l process that guides, manages, and determines different
mental issues. It also determ ines other processes that are mentally
involving. The term is derived from a computer science term. And it refers
to the functionality of the compu ter programs. When broken down, the term
simply means; meta which means something on a higher level, and
programs means the instructions that help run a computer or PC.
Metaprograms are known as the primary and main programs that are known
as a built-in behavior . And they direct other programs on the computer and
that is generally your mind. When it comes to NLP, there are many
metaprograms. There are five that are outlined and will come in variations
when used on the internet.
Metaprograms comes in two dimensions, nobody fits strict ly into one
version. And there are people who fit on both versions. This is because the
describe the reasons why people  behave the way they do, and how they can
be placed categorically . And they are not meant to separate people’ s traits
and behavior . The most common metaprograms identify who the mind
works and show  how the mind works and will gauge the behavior involved.
It involves sameness and the dif ference
The sameness version is always motivated with similar things, they know
similarities and always look for activities that are within their comfort zone.
The familiarity sense makes them assured of what they want and ends up
liking the things they are lookin g for. And also, all the situations from past
experiences. And when it is repeated it’ s good to them.
On the other hand, the difference in version always sees the difference in
things. They are always excited and open to know different things, embrace
change and try new things. They look for things that are not consistent and
they quickly change them. They  always want to change things even though
there is no need to do that. They know and understand possibilities by
knowing and understanding the dif ferences.
Away and towards something
It is simply put that these people on the towards traits are most ly driven by
the idea of reaching their goals. They get their satisfaction and pleasure
from goal achiev ement. What motivates them is having to set goals, that is
done easily and frequently . Their desire to achieve motivates them to
complete their to-do list. And in the end, gives them the feeling of being
satisfied.
The other ones mean that they are only focused on moving away from any
pain or the risk that might be encountered. What drives them is the ability to
go away from problems. They believe that they are safe and comfortable.
They are free from any issues and any problems before doing anything.
External and internal
The ones in the internal part always set their standards. They set standards
that make them comfortable with approval and making decisions. They
don’t look for any evidence that they did a good job or they are making the
right decision. They always have a feeling when they do anything right and
believe they have met their set goals and standards. They get demotivated
when given too much inform ation and they always need space to
accomplish their goals.
The ones on the external version and dependent on others for approval,
directions, and standards from other people. They like to be managed and
supervised and always like to get a pat on the back each time they do
something. This gesture makes them feel like they are known, appreciated
and approved. When they don’t get any feedback, they always have low
motivation and are not sure of their capabilities.
The procedure involved and options
Of these  options, they always look for what is best for them,  when they
have an overview  of anything and everything. They are not into finer details
and prefer more choices. They have the options of exploring more things
about themselves.
The ones that are involved with the procedure, they always work hard when
there are answers presented to them. They organize all the details needed,
and always make sure they do things the right wat as needed. They always
wish they are given all information, like following routines and structures
and this helps them to work ef ficiently .
Reactive and that what is proactive
For the proactiv e version, they are known as initiators. They always carry
own with their tasks with no delays. They are only concerned with what is
present and not worry a lot about what is to come later. They always have
their focus on what is real, and that all things are concrete and should be
true. They always concentrate on their tasks; that which is accomplished or
to be accomplished.
The reactive one, spend a lot of time planning each time and always
analyzing everything around them. All their decisions have to under go a
highly considered planned strategy . They create their own timeframe and
dedicating their time to know what to accomplish. They always focus on
what to access and schedule. And always waiting for the right time to
prepare and do a task.
There are instances whereby most people will have a mixed pattern and
versions. And others lean on one side more than the other . Despite all that,
NLP metaprograms are interesting part and move into the huma n mind and
enable them to understand themselves. The variations enable people to
understand other human beings  and make them work for the better. They
always gain an understanding of other people personal preferen ces and also
their habits. And also creates more connections. NLP helps to gain the full
control of the mind and also identifies how the mind functions; this makes it
effective when functioning and always helps develop a positive mind frame.
Work hard in whatever their roles are.
 
The NLP Communication Model
This model indicates that everyone is always in a sort of a loop of their
behavior . And an internal response is created by their external habit. The
internal reaction  then makes the person respond in a given  way. It is
believed that an external habit equally creates another internal response. As
discussed earlier , it is believed that all the NLP system indicates that all the
external habits are normally caused by experiences with the sensory system.
This includes the olfactory , gustatory , kinesthetics, auditory , and visual
senses.
This means that any internal response is always caused by the senses and
causes behaviors in a certain way. Any internal response that is caused by
any external habit, is about a collection of internal process and the internal
state. And these are the different ways to express sensory experiences.
Things like self-talk, monolog ue, and sounds created in the mind are
referred to as an internal process. And the feelings, the emotional
expression, and experience are termed an internal state.
 
The Common Strategies of NLP
NLP is always about strategies; it involves internal and externa l habits and
uses planned strategies of the habits and the reaction. It uses different plans
and approaches to explain the human behavior and the ways it can change.
Most of the strategies and approaches used for NLP are on a short-term
basis. There are known strateg ies that are used, and how they are used
typically and always depends on the use.
Modeling
It is believed that the theory used for NLP was started on modeling. This is
known as the way to find about what a person believes in, like the
physiology . It also means the understanding of people menta l plans and
strategies. And in the long run af fects the behavior of others, how they think
and their general behavior . It’s generally used to find the approaches used
and the behavior of the person affecting them mentally and understand the
patterns adapted and what is used in achieving roles and duties delegated.
For insta nce, this is when a person gains knowledge of a new skill or maybe
a language.
When a person wants to learn a new language, they need to know three
things in the model:
They will need to know the vocabulary being used and understanding the
vocabulary .
The second thing is to know and learn the syntax. This s where  one is able
to put all the words together and construct a sentence.
The last model is understanding the lip movement or mouth movement.
This is because each language has a different way of the mouth moving and
the pronunciation is different. And he catches is to understa nd that and
converse clearly .
The theory clearly indicates that the models can be found in all habits.
When you clearly understand all the behavioral patterns in all the models,
the probability to change is very high. An example, if you are at work and
the rate at which you respond to emails is not okay with you. Or you are not
happy with it, it is a high time to look into the model used in responding.
Change what you do not like about it and look for another one that is
productive and appealing.

INTRODUCTION
In this day and age of cut throat competition, it becomes all
the more important for people to utilize their full mental
capacity in order to achieve the heights of success. Not doing
so migh t result in being left behind, while the competition
forges ahead.
All human beings have the potential to multitask and can
finish arduous tasks within a matter of minutes. But not
everybody is able to do so, and only those that truly
capitalizes on their mental abilities, by training their minds
to delve into the depths of knowledge, will be able to attain
due success!
There will always be winners and those that will look up to
them in envy . If everybody were to be the former , then we
would end up in a world where no competition would exist.
However , the main goal for most humans is to be a winner
and leave the competition behind.
So what is it that helps these winners achieve the kind of
success that they experience in life and what do the others
lack? W ell, the answer lies in three simple letters, NLP .
NLP stands for Neuro Linguistic Programming and refers to
concept that allows people to control their own and other
people’ s minds, while influenci ng thought and behavior; to
attain more out of life.
In this book, we will look at the meaning of NLP, explore its
core concepts and also see how you can implement it in your
day-to-day life. There are specific chapters dedicated to
understanding the concept of NLP, exploring its meaning,
steps to implement in your life and also a few tips on small
talk.
I thank you for choosing this book and hope you have a good
time reading it.
Let us begin.
 
CHAPTER 1 
WHAT IS NLP? 
NLP is a core concept of psychology . It stands for Neuro
Linguistic Programming.
NLP was first introduced in 1970 by Richard Brandler and
John Grinder . Grinder , a linguistics expert and Brandler an
author , explored the dimensions of human psychology in
terms of mind and behavior control.
They were some of the first ones to tell humans that it is
possible to attain more from life by making use of both sides
of the brain. They are said to have been heavily influenced
by the work of psychologi sts Virginia Satir, Milton
Erickson and Fritz Perls.
In fact, Brandler closely worked  with Perls and Satir to come
up with the dif ferent ideologies of NLP .
NLP mainly deals with people capitalizing on their
brainpower and doing more by tapping into their complete
mental capacity .
I know it sounds a bit complex but it is actually quite easy.
You have to first understand the basic concept and then go
about exploiting it. Through the course of this book, we will
look at how you can do so with ease.
Through extens ive study or educated people, Brandler and
Grinder found that despite having similar educational
backgrounds, some people were able to exploit their
education and do more in their life whereas some were
unable to put it to good use and would end up failing at
finishing the task at hand.
This made them realize that having good education alone
was not helping these people succeed and there was
something more that was allowing them to for ge ahead. They
decided to investigate and find out what really set these
successful people apart and what extra they possessed that
helped them get to where they were.
Once they were done with their research, they were surprised
to know that the successful people had a different way of
communicating with others, which helped them succeed
better . The ones that were not succeeding as much were not
able to communicate with others well enough. So, they
decided to compile a set of rules that would allow people to
communicate better and thus the concepts of NLP were
formed.
What sets NLP apart from the rest of the concepts that are
out there is the fact that it mainl y deals with focusing on the
solution as opposed to the problem. Many psychologists
spend a lot of time listening to a person’ s problems and make
a big deal out of trying to analyze and present these
problems. However , NLP will focus on the solution and
come up with a feasible one that help the person implement
it with ease.
NLP is a concept where people make use of the information
that they have and try to apply it practically in the different
real life situations that they come across on a daily basis. As
you know, everybody is required to take full advantage of
their education and that can be done through the
implementation of NLP. Communication is a key aspect and
NLP teaches people to both communicate internally with
themselves and also externally with the outside world.
The concept is generally taught by experts who have
extensive knowledge on the subject. Many schools and
colleges now make use of NLP  to teach students and help
them understand how they can use their existing knowledge
and put it to good use.
Problem solving is one of the main implementations of NLP.
It is not limited  to looking at the issue through a single
viewpoint and deals with analyzing it through several
different viewpoints before arriving at a feasible solution. It
is about expanding the horizon s of thought and looking at
the bigger picture.
Now you might be wondering as to who is NLP for? And
whether you will be able to take it up and implement it in
your life.
NLP will be beneficial for a whole host of people and there
is no hard and fast rule that says only certain types of people
can take it up. Let us look at who can truly benefit by
employing the theories of NLP in their life.
Working profes sionals will have the chance to maximize
their career opportunities by making use of NLP. As you
know , everybody in the rat race wishes to outdo the other in
order to be a leader. With the help of NLP, the person will
know to make a quick decision and find a solution that will
help solve a problem. He or she will also be able to deal with
everyday issues with ease thereby increasing their level of
productivity .
Students can make use of NLP to excel in their studies. NLP
mainly deals with enhancing internal communication and the
child will be able to remember the concepts better , and for a
longer period of time. NLP is a simple concept and children
will not have to take up rigorou s mental tasks to understand
and implement it. Parents can start introducing the concept
to them and they will successfully get their child started on
it.
NLP is also for elders. It will help in making their everyday
life easy. They will not have to put in too much effort to find
solutions to their problems and they can extrapolate and
arrive at quick and feasible solutions to their issues. NLP is a
technique that many elders employ in their day-to-day life,
as it is quite simple to understand as well.
Remember that the different problems that you will come
across will all have the same thing at their core and you will
have to get to it and make use of your common knowledge to
solve them.
MIND CONTROL AND COERCION
Mind control and coercion are two different things. Mind
control isn’t coercion and it doesn’ t make use of any of the
tricks or techniques that are made use of in coercion.
Coercion is the act where the controller wants to have his
own way, regardless of the feelings, emotions or thoughts of
the person whom he is coercing. Threats, humiliation and
even guilt can be made use of for achieving the end result in
coercion. By now you would have understood that there isn’t
anything positive about coercio n. To coerce an individual
means that you are forcefully making them behave or act in a
certain manner that they didn’ t want to and this isn’t what
mind control is about. In mind  control you don’t force an
individual to go against their basic beliefs.
The stark difference between coercion and mind control is
that coercion doesn’ t understand  the workings of the mind of
the person who is being coerce d. Coercion is used by most
of the cults and leaders for controlling the minds of others. If
you have read the Harry Potter books or have seen the
movies then you would realize that Lord Voldemort made
use of coercion for controlling people by threatening to kill
or torture them if they don’ t follow him.
MIND CONTROL AND PERSUASION
Mind control and persuasion  are closely interlinked.
However , they are different from one another . It is important
that you understand the difference between these two. For
getting a better idea of this concept, take into consideration

NLP and blame
The human psyche can take the blame, put it in a bag, and that bag

And why? We delete it and ask for something to disappear . We use

It will not happen by itself.
When it does not go away , it can create several health problems.
So what should we do with guilt?
Let’s first see what guilt is. Guilt is a feeling. Feelings have something

Indeed, if we feel a feeling and learn from emotion, we must continue.
If guilty , find a quiet place where you can “be” with your feelin gs. Go

When you follow the sensation through your body , follow this path so
as not to judge for yourself. Just experience it as a physical sensation. Your
comment explai ning why it happened or why it is the fault will only slow
the process down.
It’s a feeling. Y ou have many things to learn.
If you notice that you want to wear it as a trophy , keep that in mind.
Ask yourself what this part is for. Sometimes, the beliefs we collect from
families and groups do not serve our ability to live a full and happy life. In
NLP, the first thing to understand is that we are “at the root” of our
experiences.
Our journey here on planet Earth is exciting, and it is our inner world
that contains excellent growth opportunities.
Make the law of attraction work for you
Many people have been expo sed to the law of attraction  while
watching the movie “Secret”. And, for those who really want to understand
this deep ly, there is also the work of Abraham-Hicks, which delves into the
law of attraction . There is no doubt that this is a very powerful work. So
while some people benefit great ly, others simply feel frustrated when trying

Why is that? The law of attraction, as described in Abraham-Hic ks and
The Secret, is correct. The problem is how to change what attracts when
what attracts doesn’ t work. What makes it easy for you to expre ss what you
want is the complete agreement between your intention and what you
believe to be true. This means that what you consciously want to conform

those that undermine this connec tion and cause an unconscious attraction to

Restrictive decis ions are decisions made at a very young age (usually
before 6 or 7 years old) when we had very little experience, perspective,
and development. These are decisions like “I’m stupid, lifeless, worthless
...” They  were made at different times, on an unconscious level, depending

had no consciou s tools to give them meaning. They were trapped in our
muscle contractions, our breathing patterns, and our neural network
patterns. And, in the areas where we have made decisions, they have
become the fundamental structure of how we now interpret life and what is
now manifesting  in our lives. For example, if you decide to be rude, it
would be more difficult to attract healthy relationships. This will likely
attract relationships that reinforce your belief that you are not loved.
When the unconscious makes a limited decision, they invest heavily to
prove that the decision is true. Therefore, they are constantly looking for
evidence that the decision is true in the way they interpret the experiences
that occu r and attracts people or situations. And so, in an attempt to use the
law of attraction  and to follow the principles set out in The Secret, when
you try to focus  and visualize what you want if there is a limiting decision
in this area, you may encounter resistance, sometimes very considerable
resistance; and the subconscio us is likely to sabotage your efforts and
prevent you from attracting what you want. But once this restrictive
decision is removed, you can easily attract what you want.
Advising the NLP schedule is a very effective way to eliminate
restrictive decisions. NLP Chro nology is a robust process of NLP (neuro-

change. NLP   chronology is structured according to the functio ning of the
brain. This bring s you back to the initial cases where you made restrictive
decisions that cling to things that are not working well in your life, to clean
them up. The hypnosis process helps you access functions that are not
usually in your conscious memory .
NLP and how it helps us gr ow
Have you ever heard of NLP (neuro-linguistic programming)?  It is a
beneficial behavioral science that can literally help you change your life.
It was develop ed in the 1970s and combined techniques from
neurology , computer science, and linguistics to help people realize their
potential. Let’ s take a closer look at what it is and how it works.
Described as the science of excellence in humans, NLP is about
modeling the language structure and behavior of successful individuals.
What it basically means is that to be happy and prosperous, you will
not be wrong if you think, speak, and behave in the same way as happy and
successful indiv iduals. If you include NLP in your speech, you are able to
convince other people more successfully!
The basics
NLP has many variations, so there is controversy among practitioners
that other people are not doing it right. However , despite these often-
debated issues, the basic principles remain the same, and everyone agrees
that it works in a way that makes a person’ s life more fulfilling.
The two main principles of NLP are: The map is not a territory , and
life and mind are systemic processes. What do these principles mean to
you?
1. A map is not a territory - What it basically means is that people do
not really have the means to understand reality . Instead of following our
concept, these notions could also be wrong.
Our senses are used to shape a map of what we believe to exist, and
these maps determine our behavior , not reality itself. So, if your card is
sharp or distorted, you will behave the same way .
We use our senses to create a map of what we believe to exist. It is
these cards that determine our behavior , not reality itself. If your card is
asymmetrical, you will also behave asymmetrically .
2. Life and mind are systemic processes - This means that what is
going on in your mind and body , between you and your environment,
cannot be separated from each other . Trying to do it will not end in success.
Whichever NLP  method you encounter , it will be based on these
principles. The techniques are there to help us understand how our brain
works, how we store information, and how we can change our behavior
instead of the right one.
 
The benefits of UFOs
Specific ways that NLP can help you:
1. Your career - NLP helps you to be more effective in your career by
strengthening your skills in teamwork, personal development, coaching,
leadership, sales, and productivi ty. No matter what, if there is potential for
growth and interaction, NLP will help you.
2. Achieving Goals - NLP can help you not only to set goals but also
to achie ve them, provided the goals are not random, unintelligent,
meaningless, or impossible to achieve.
For example, no program guarantees that you will earn milli ons of
dollars per month if you are not already able to do so.
On the other hand, NLP can help you strengthen your skills and the
way you comm unicate with others. It can help you change the way you
think and speak and motivate you to take action to achieve your goals.
3. Mental health - If you have mental or emotional issues and phobias,
NLP can help you overcome them.
4. NLP can help you live a happier and more fulfilled life.
If you are intere sted in finding out how you can make a difference in
your life, NLP may be the answer you are looking for .
NLP studies people who have succeeded and what steps they have
used to succeed. The steps can come from any part of your life.
Whether you want to conquer a phobia or learn to speak confide ntly in
front of an audience, if you want to have reliable and loving relationships,
NLP techniques can help you in your quest. Learn more about  the options
NLP offers, and you will be amazed at the positive differenc es they can
cause in your life.
How can this benefit us?
Neuro-linguistic programming (or NLP as it is commonly known) has
been described in several ways, for example as a user manual for the brain,
as a science of success and as a model of success. I describe it as the
language inherent in the brain, how you understand it, and how you act in
this communica tion. It helps people use a wide variety of principles and
techniques to better control how they think, feel, and behave  in order to
achieve the desired results.
The specific name of this technology , neuro-linguistic program ming,
can be divided as follows:
Neuro, which involves the brain and how information reaches our
senses
Linguistics: a language that we use both verbally and non-verbally ,
including how we represent the world internally using images, sounds, and
feelings.
Programming: reason to accomplish the ideal outcomes. In NLP
terminology , this is called “strategy ,” and we all have a strategy for
everything we do, from the most basic to the most complex.
 
How can NLP benefit us?
Most things: devices, equipmen t, etc. are supplied with a user manual.
Therefore, it is surprising that the most complex machine unit known to
man, the brain, does not have such a user guide.
Isn’t that more wonderful than the one with NLP, maybe for the first
time in human history , we now have an operational guide that we can use to
improve all aspects of our lives?
The most interesting thing about all of this is that anyone can “do it”.
Do you know someone who always seems to get results with each attempt? 
Let people focus their success solely on “happiness”: at NLP, we don’t
believe in happi ness. NLP is based on the assumption that by modeling the
method and excellence of successful people, we can also create our own
success in others.
The key observations we give when modeling successful people in any
field are:
i) What do they see?
ii) What do they mean?
iii) How do they feel?
To be successfu l in any area of    life, we need to understan d and
develop these three key areas.
Imagine when you had to do something, and you were worried: how
did it affect you? On the contrary , how did you feel when you did
something that you liked? How  did it affect your behavior? The way we
feel affects our behavior: the feeling of anxiety negatively affects the
desired result, while the feeling of well-being has a positive impact.
Like our feelings, our thoughts affect our behavior . Ask yourself this:
if I have negative thoughts about myself, will it leave me in a healthy
emotional state?   However , if you could remember a time in the past when
you were perfect, it would make you feel better and more resourceful,
right?
Here is what NLP is: you take responsibility for all aspects of your life
and eliminate control resources.  Now that you think about it, take the time
and list the goals you want to achieve in life. What would that mean to you;
and what do you need to change to get them?
NLP and one step too far
For me, one of the most powerful aspects of NLP is the basic principle
that we, as individuals, are responsible for our reactions to the behavior of
others. It’s a great place to start, as it combines empowerment and the
recognition of the ability to control one’s responses with knowledge and
understanding that others cannot control. Wonderful, we are responsible for
ourselves!
It was that basic! Some coaches (I’m in a hurry to add, not the people
who coached me, who were beautiful) use this, and other NLP techniques
and tools, as simple, quick fixes, but I don’t think the life is like that.
Sometimes, it can be much more difficult, much more complex,  and there is
a return to basics, rather than specific tools.
For example, one of the phrases that I hear too often “overuse” (once
would be too often in my book!) is “I’m sorry you took it” or variations on
the theme. I think it is possible  to use this expression in a respectable and
useful way. Still, more often than not, I hear it in a way that is closely
related to the taking of power over another person or the renunciation of
responsibility for my actions.
The fundamental problem is balance. If I walk around saying and
doing what I want to someone else, with a smug and satisfied smile from
someone who just turns around and says “it’ s your choice”, “you let me hurt
you”, “I choose to do it” I am on someone level may be right, but I show no
respect, no responsibility , not even decency .
In these circumstances, the balance is out of position. The two weights
on the scale in evil Neuro-linguistic programmer mode are:
1) You are responsible for your reaction to me.
2) I am not responsible for your reaction to me.
In this case, the weights are actually on the same side, but they are on
the other person’ s hand. Although he does not demon strate any
responsibility , he expects the other person to assume full responsibility .
You don’t have to change a lot of words to translate this into a much
more principled, appropriate, and decent weight upgrade on a defined scale:
1) I take responsibility for your reaction to me.
2) Many are not even answerable for my reaction to you.
In this case, the weights are only on one side again, but they are on
your side, not on the other . After all, it is your weight in the first place: you
cannot only impose them on others.
A significant difference between  the two is that the first set, although
somewhat respe ctful according to NLP, completely misses the point that we
must all start to take ownership - it is about us and what exists from the
inside, without imposing it on others. The second set shows full ownership
and is therefore much more in line with the NLP principle approach.
